name: metrics_bam
description: Metrics of one bam tile instance, one row per sweep

sample_id.description: Identifier shared by every row of one sweep

sample_slot.description: Slot that triggered the sweep, 0 for periodic sweeps

sample_snapct_state.description: Snapshot load state entered, for snapct_state sweeps; unknown otherwise

sample_caught_up.description: Whether replay had caught up to the cluster tip when the sweep was taken (replay IsCaughtUp); set once per run, never cleared

sample_tile_cnt.description: Tile instances in the sweep, to detect partial sweeps

kind_id.description: Index of this tile instance among tiles of its kind

tid.description: Thread ID of the tile. Same as Pid in production, but might differ in development

last_cpu_index.description: CPU the tile last ran on

context_switch_involuntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Involuntary context switches

context_switch_voluntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Voluntary context switches

page_fault_major.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Major page faults

page_fault_minor.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Minor page faults

heartbeat_time.description: Last wall-clock time the tile heartbeated

is_backpressured.description: Whether the tile is currently backpressured

backpressure.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Times the tile waited for one or more consumers to catch up to resume publishing

regime_duration_nanos.description: Tile wall time, by regime; regimes are exhaustive and groups Busy, Idle, Backpressure and Housekeeping partition it

thread_duration_nanos.description: Thread wall time since start, by scheduler state; Idle is the remainder, so parts sum to about the lifetime.  User, System and Interrupt have 10 ms resolution; Interrupt is 0 unless the tile is pinned

wait.description: Wait (task was runnable but not scheduled)

user.description: User (task was scheduled and executing in user mode)

system.description: System (task was scheduled and executing in kernel mode)

interrupt.description: Interrupt (CPU time stolen by hardirq/softirq handlers or a hypervisor; fixed tiles only)

park_attempted.description: Times the tile tried to park while idle (efficient mode), by result

pending.description: Pre-park recheck found work, did not park

device_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Device IRQs on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 for tiles not pinned

tlb_shootdown.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. TLB shootdowns on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 for tiles not pinned

timer_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Local timer interrupts (LOC) on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 for tiles not pinned

enabled.description: Boolean gauge: 1 when BAM is enabled by operator, 0 when disabled

healthy.description: Boolean gauge: 1 when the BAM client transport, auth, config, scheduler stream, and BuilderHeartBeat recency checks are healthy; otherwise 0. This does not imply that fresh work for the current leader slot has arrived yet.

stream_live.description: Boolean gauge: 1 while the BAM scheduler gRPC stream is open, from its response headers on, 0 otherwise. The BAM node may still reject an open stream; bam_stream_transition counts accepted streams

leader_state_slot.description: Latest validator leader slot carried in pack->bam leader-state snapshots, or 0 if none has been observed yet

leader_state_tick.description: Latest validator leader tick carried in pack->bam leader-state snapshots

leader_state_slot_end_nanos.description: Latest validator leader slot_end_ns carried in pack->bam leader-state snapshots (nanoseconds), or 0 if unknown

transaction_published.description: Cumulative number of transactions published from BAM to verify, including transactions unpacked from bundles

atomic_batch_published.description: Cumulative number of revert_on_error AtomicTxnBatch entries published to verify as atomic BAM batches

feedback_results_dropped.description: Cumulative number of BAM feedback results dropped because the local result queue was full, a result link was overrun, the validator identity or BAM endpoint changed, BAM was disabled, or the BAM node repeated a scheduler stream rejection while no leader slot in the current epoch was known

ingress_packet_oversize.description: Cumulative number of BAM packets rejected because their protobuf data payload exceeded the local transaction MTU

builder_heartbeats_decoded.description: Cumulative number of builder heartbeat messages successfully decoded from the BAM node

failure.description: Cumulative number of BAM control-plane or session failures by class. Scheduler payload and AtomicTxnBatch rejects are counted separately in bam_ingress_batch_rejected.

auth_challenge_decode.description: Local protobuf or validation failure while decoding bam_api.AuthChallengeResponse

config_decode.description: Local protobuf decode failure while decoding bam_api.ConfigResponse

scheduler_envelope_decode.description: Local protobuf or scheduler-envelope decode failure while decoding bam_api.SchedulerResponse

request_failed.description: HTTP or gRPC request completed with a non-OK status

resolve.description: DNS resolution failure while resolving the BAM endpoint

connect.description: TCP connect failure while establishing the BAM transport

io.description: TLS, HTTP/2, or stream I/O failure on an established BAM connection

unsupported_version.description: Unsupported scheduler-response version received from the BAM peer

request_timeout.description: Auth, config, or scheduler-stream gRPC request timed out

builder_activity_timeout.description: Scheduler-stream BuilderHeartBeat watchdog timed out while the scheduler stream was live

connect_timeout.description: TCP, TLS, or HTTP/2 handshake did not complete within 5 seconds of dialing

heap_size.description: Total workspace capacity reserved for the BAM tile (bytes). Sampled at most once per second to avoid repeated workspace scans.

heap_free_bytes.description: Estimated free capacity in the BAM tile workspace heap (bytes). Sampled at most once per second to avoid repeated workspace scans.

keepalive_acks.description: Cumulative number of HTTP/2 keepalive PING acknowledgments received from the BAM node

healthy_connects.description: Cumulative number of transitions into BAM CONNECTED_HEALTHY state

healthy_disconnects.description: Cumulative number of transitions out of BAM CONNECTED_HEALTHY state

grpc_stream_chunks_tx.description: Cumulative number of BAM unary gRPC request bodies (auth challenge and config) fully written to the HTTP/2 send buffer with END_STREAM. Scheduler-stream messages are not counted.

grpc_stream_chunks_tx_bytes.description: Cumulative number of outbound HTTP/2 bytes of all frame types, before TLS encryption, handed by the BAM gRPC client to the transport

grpc_stream_chunks_rx.description: Cumulative number of inbound BAM gRPC message segments processed from HTTP/2 DATA payloads. One DATA frame can yield several segments when it carries several messages or arrives in pieces.

grpc_stream_chunks_rx_bytes.description: Cumulative number of inbound HTTP/2 bytes of all frame types, after TLS decryption, received by the BAM gRPC client from the transport

grpc_requests_sent.description: Cumulative number of BAM gRPC requests started (auth challenge, config, and scheduler-stream calls), counted when the request is queued, whether or not its body has finished sending

grpc_streams_active.description: Current number of HTTP/2 streams opened by the BAM gRPC client that are not closed, as counted against the BAM node's concurrent-stream limit

ingress_multi_message_received.description: Cumulative number of multiple_atomic_txn_batch messages decoded from BAM ingress

ingress_batch_commit_attempt.description: Cumulative number of AtomicTxnBatch entries that entered BAM validate/commit

ingress_batch_published.description: Cumulative number of AtomicTxnBatch entries successfully published to verify

transaction_rejected_backpressure.description: Cumulative number of BAM scheduler transactions rejected because the pending transaction queue lacked capacity

ingress_batch_rejected.description: Cumulative number of AtomicTxnBatch entry rejects by reason after decode and batch-level validation. Wrapper-level message rejects are counted separately in bam_ingress_message_rejected.

invalid_batch.description: Batch rejected because AtomicTxnBatch decode or structural validation failed

empty_batch.description: Batch rejected because it contained zero packets

vote_transaction.description: Batch rejected because it contained a simple vote transaction

ingress_message_rejected.description: Cumulative number of multiple_atomic_txn_batch wrapper rejects by reason. These count scheduler messages, not AtomicTxnBatch entries.

empty_message.description: multiple_atomic_txn_batch wrapper rejected because it contained zero AtomicTxnBatch entries

overflow_message.description: multiple_atomic_txn_batch wrapper rejected because it exceeded the local max batch count

outbound_enqueue_outcome.description: Cumulative number of BAM outbound leader-state, result, and heartbeat fd_grpc_client_stream_send outcomes on a live scheduler stream. Sends deferred because the stream is not live or the gRPC client cannot accept another message yet are not counted.

leader_state_enqueued.description: Leader-state message accepted by gRPC stream_send

leader_state_enqueue_fail.description: Leader-state send attempted but fd_grpc_client_stream_send returned failure

result_enqueued.description: Result message accepted by gRPC stream_send

result_enqueue_fail.description: Result send attempted but fd_grpc_client_stream_send returned failure

heartbeat_enqueued.description: Validator heartbeat message accepted by gRPC stream_send

heartbeat_enqueue_fail.description: Validator heartbeat send attempted on a live scheduler stream but fd_grpc_client_stream_send returned failure

stream_transition.description: Cumulative number of scheduler stream acceptance transitions. A stream counts as accepted from the BAM node's first BuilderHeartBeat; one the node rejects after its response headers is counted in bam_failure instead.

down_to_live.description: Scheduler stream accepted: the BAM node sent its first BuilderHeartBeat

leader_pending_dropped.description: Cumulative number of pending leader-state updates cleared before send because the BAM client reset, the scheduler request failed, or the stream ended/timed out

client_reset.description: Pending leader-state cleared because BAM client was reset

request_failed.description: Pending leader-state cleared because scheduler stream request failed

stream_ended.description: Pending leader-state cleared because scheduler stream ended

stream_timeout.description: Pending leader-state cleared because scheduler stream timed out

leader_state_suppressed.description: Cumulative number of pack-provided BAM leader-state updates suppressed or cleared because the state was not locally live

not_leader.description: Leader-state send suppressed because pack reported no active leader slot

expired.description: Leader-state send suppressed because slot_end_ns was known and already elapsed

scheduler_rejected.description: Retained leader state cleared because the scheduler rejected it as outside the valid slot range

leader_pending_replaced.description: Cumulative number of pending leader-state updates replaced by a newer leader-state update before send

slot_ingress_result.description: Cumulative number of BAM slot-ingress records finalized after they aged out of the local retention window, bucketed by the first scheduler-receive callback for that slot relative to slot end or as unknown when slot_end_ns was unavailable

no_ingress.description: No BAM ingress was observed for the slot before its local retention window expired

first_before_end.description: The first BAM ingress observed for the slot arrived before slot end

first_after_end.description: The first BAM ingress observed for the slot arrived after slot end

unknown_slot_end.description: BAM ingress was observed for the slot but slot_end_ns was unavailable when the slot aged out of the retention window

slot_ingress_transactions.description: Cumulative number of BAM ingress transactions counted in finalized ingress rollups using scheduler-receive callback timestamps, bucketed as before-end or after-end only when slot_end_ns was known at observation time, else unknown

before_end.description: BAM ingress transactions observed before slot end

after_end.description: BAM ingress transactions observed after slot end

unknown_slot_end.description: BAM ingress transactions observed while slot_end_ns was unavailable

healthy_leader_slot_result.description: Cumulative number of local leader slots that reached slot_end_ns while BAM status was CONNECTED_HEALTHY, bucketed by whether fresh current-slot BAM work had arrived before slot end

fresh_work.description: Healthy BAM-owned leader slot ended after fresh current-slot BAM work arrived before slot end

no_fresh_work.description: Healthy BAM-owned leader slot ended without fresh current-slot BAM work arriving before slot end

scheduler_pong_send_outcome.description: Cumulative number of BAM scheduler Ping-to-Pong send outcomes, including local send-boundary contention and live-stream fd_grpc_client_stream_send results

enqueued.description: Pong message was accepted by fd_grpc_client_stream_send on a live scheduler stream

frame_tx_busy.description: Scheduler Ping arrived on a live stream but the local HTTP/2 TX frame buffer was not empty, so Pong was skipped

request_busy.description: Scheduler Ping arrived on a live stream but a gRPC request body was still sending, so Pong was skipped

send_fail.description: Pong send was attempted on a live scheduler stream after local readiness checks but fd_grpc_client_stream_send returned failure

keepalive_rtt_sample.description: Latest HTTP/2 keepalive round-trip time sample captured at scrape time (nanoseconds)

keepalive_rtt_smoothed.description: Exponentially smoothed HTTP/2 keepalive round-trip time estimate (nanoseconds)

keepalive_rtt_deviation.description: Smoothed HTTP/2 keepalive RTT variation estimate (nanoseconds)

keepalive_rtt_valid.description: Boolean gauge: 1 after the first HTTP/2 keepalive RTT sample has been observed, 0 before RTT estimates are initialized

feedback_queue_depth.description: Current number of BAM feedback results buffered for send

pending_transactions.description: Current number of validated BAM scheduler transactions buffered and waiting for bam_verif credits

current_leader_slot_first_ingress_state.description: One-hot state for the current leader slot's first observed scheduler-receive callback relative to slot end. Exactly one enum bucket is exported as 1 for the current local view; all others are 0.

no_ingress.description: No scheduler-receive callback has been observed yet for the current leader slot

slot_end_unknown.description: A first scheduler-receive callback was observed for the current leader slot but slot_end_ns is not known yet

before_end.description: The first scheduler-receive callback observed for the current leader slot arrived before slot end

after_end.description: The first scheduler-receive callback observed for the current leader slot arrived at or after slot end

builder_heartbeat_arrival_delta_nanos.description: Distribution of remote BuilderHeartBeat timestamp to local scheduler-stream receive callback delta (nanoseconds); includes clock offset and is intended only for relative trend analysis

scheduler_pong_send_nanos.description: Distribution of local BAM scheduler Ping-to-Pong send-boundary turnaround from scheduler-message receive callback to local readiness classification or fd_grpc_client_stream_send outcome on a live scheduler stream (nanoseconds). This is local processing and send-boundary latency, not network RTT.
